source_record._note: canonical_url is a repo-relative path, not an external URL -- deliberate, see the companion .md's 'First use of BALI_ZERO_POLICY' section: a repo-tracked file's content_sha256 is exactly the git blob hash and is reproducible forever, unlike an OFFICIAL_PORTAL page with a per-request CSRF token. freshness_policy is null because a repo file has no external re-verification clock to run against (MAX_AGE_SINCE_VERIFIED_AT would be meaningless here); if house convention requires a non-null freshness_policy on every source_record regardless of authority_type, the fold author should confirm that against the schema before applying, since this draft has not verified whether freshness_policy is truly optional at the schema level for non-portal sources specifically, only that the Pydantic field itself defaults to None.
